cleanup_policy.when: Never automatically. Agents must not delete tmp/ or tmp/<audit_id>/ at task end. A human operator may clean tmp/<audit_id>/ only after durable deliverables under reports/ are confirmed retained.
forbidden_actions: writing durable final deliverables under tmp/
writing durable final deliverables under audited application source trees outside reports/

audit_id.source: Assigned once by security-audit-orchestrator and reused by recon, audit, correlation, final-report, third-party-review, and optimization artifacts.

agent_session_id.source: Use the session id provided by the orchestrator. Coverage sessions follow <language-or-platform-or-ai>-<focus-area>-<sink|control|config>-coverage-r<round>; hypothesis sessions follow <language-or-platform-or-ai>-<focus-area>-<blind|seeded-variant>-r<round>.

reports.location_rule: All durable audit deliverables MUST be written under the workspace-root reports/ directory. Never place final reports, SARIF, coverage verification, correlation, finding adjudication, attack-chain, or vulnerability-mining artifacts under tmp/ or inside audited application/test source trees outside reports/.

final_report.cardinality: one final synthesized report per audit_id
final_report.notes: Build the digest-bound report model from the verified coverage summary, trusted adjudication input/output, and Attack-chain v2 manifest with build-final-report-model.mjs. Every supported finding preserves its Finding v2 attack_surface block and immutable source pointer, and the deterministic Markdown renderer emits those facts. Render the Markdown only with render-final-report.mjs, byte-verify it with verify-final-report.mjs, and never write conclusion text by hand. The human-readable final audit report is a durable deliverable. Write it only under reports/final/. Once its SHA-256 is submitted to vuln-judger, keep it immutable and publish review results as companion artifacts.

stage_handoff.format: digest-bound JSON input/output envelopes plus one aggregate verification
stage_handoff.cardinality: one INPUT and one OUTPUT envelope per agent invocation; one aggregate verification per audit round
stage_handoff.producer: security-audit-orchestrator and invoked agent via audit-artifact-management stage contract scripts
stage_handoff.notes: The registry fixes every stage/agent payload and artifact template. An OUTPUT binds to the exact INPUT digest. COMPLETE requires all contract-required artifact bindings and zero gaps. verify-stage-agent-handoffs.mjs derives every Focus Area assignment/lens and required discovery-track expectation from the sealed Focus manifest, so an omitted Focus session blocks finalization even when prose says the phase is done.

static_analysis.cardinality: one file per agent session when static-analysis tools are used
static_analysis.notes: Normalize static-analysis output to SARIF even when the underlying tool produces another format.

vulnerability_mining.cardinality: one file per source or platform vulnerability-mining agent session
vulnerability_mining.notes: Coverage reports use schema_version=2 and finding_schema_version=2. Each accounting session uses discovery_track=coverage, one Focus Area assignment, exactly one audit_strategy, and one D1-D10 cell set. Base agents emit domain=base file/function records; ai-security-auditor assignments collectively partition the complete domain=ai overlay. Agents update entity rows only; reconcile-audit-report.mjs derives D1-D10 cells, target counts, PASS/FINDING/GAP/N/A, and digest-bound summaries. Exact arrays and reconciled cells must be accepted by intermediate verify-coverage.mjs; accepted coverage-track findings are later reconciled exactly against Coverage Ledger v3 finding artifacts.

hypothesis_discovery.cardinality: one file per Focus Area blind or seeded-variant session
hypothesis_discovery.notes: Blind and seeded-variant artifacts provide candidate evidence only. They never close D1-D10 or file/function/catalog coverage. Blind seed_inputs must be empty; seeded-variant seed_inputs must be non-empty.

threat_model.cardinality: one sealed threat model and one sealed Focus Area manifest per audit_id
threat_model.notes: The shared threat-model contract requires evidence-backed invariants, typed assumptions, at least one attacker story per threat, explicit out-of-scope stories, and project-contextual CRITICAL/HIGH/MEDIUM/LOW calibration. The threat model closes every entry point with threats or evidence-backed deprioritization. Focus Areas partition primary base and AI assignments and declare required discovery tracks.

attack_chain.notes: Schema v2 accepts only adjudicated supported findings as chain evidence. Every unknown/deployment condition remains CONDITIONAL with a bidirectional gap; every contradicted chain is explicit. Raw, accepted, and rejected chain IDs must conserve exactly.

finding_adjudication.cardinality: one trusted candidate-input manifest and one independent decision manifest per audit round
finding_adjudication.notes: The input is built only from structural accepted findings that exactly match Ledger FINDING artifacts. Every candidate receives exactly one independent terminal semantic decision and a complete attack_surface_review over all fixed fields. Only SUPPORTED_STATIC and SUPPORTED_RUNTIME are eligible for attack-chain construction or final synthesis; CANDIDATE, REJECTED, INCONCLUSIVE, and RECLASSIFIED are preserved with their evidence but cannot be upgraded by prose.

external_runtime_validation_handoff.cardinality: zero or one request per finding object digest; a downstream validation project may return zero or one bound result
external_runtime_validation_handoff.producer: request: security-finding-adjudicator or security-audit-orchestrator; result: separately authorized downstream runtime-validation project
external_runtime_validation_handoff.notes: This repository exports and validates the contract only. It never runs PoC, browser, container, network, or target code as part of this handoff. Requests require isolated-test-only policy and forbid production/third-party targets, real credentials, persistence, and data destruction. A returned result is not automatically promoted into adjudication or the final report; a later explicitly authorized project must define that import workflow.

third_party_review.cardinality: one OpenCode three-party vuln-judger review per sealed final report and audit_id
third_party_review.notes: The JSON and Markdown companions bind to the exact final report SHA-256. Per-finding and intermediate-report submissions are forbidden. A failed, stopped, partial, or digest-invalidated run must not be reported as independently reviewed.

coverage_verification.cardinality: one final artifact per audit_id; intermediate failed artifacts may be retained by round
coverage_verification.notes: Authoritative v3 gate. It runs the structural verifier itself against the exact snapshot, persists that trusted artifact, derives JSON and Markdown from the same in-memory summary, and rejects caller-supplied structural claims. Complete mode requires a bounded frozen plan, a valid FINALIZED_COMPLETE ledger, and every REQUIRED atomic check in VERIFIED state. Partial mode requires PARTIAL_CHECKPOINT and remains explicitly incomplete.

coverage_plan.notes: Schema v3 is byte-bound to one snapshot index. Every atomic check is bound to one Focus Area and one normalized source_set_id. Only explicitly CONFIRMED interfaces enter the check matrix; CANDIDATE interfaces and extractor gaps are separate unbounded-inventory blockers. NOT_APPLICABLE is planner-only and UNKNOWN blocks completion.

coverage_ledger.cardinality: one service-owned append-only ledger per audit_id
coverage_ledger.notes: Schema v3 uses a cross-process lock, continuous sequence/hash chain, and service-held HMAC key sidecar. INSPECT issues a check/session/agent-bound assignment token; cross-session work requires DELEGATE. RECEIPT binds normalized source-set evidence, typed locators, tool version, and a server-derived inline/artifact hash. FINDING decisions require exact ID-bearing artifacts. PARTIAL_CHECKPOINT is nonterminal and cannot authorize a complete claim.

coverage_structural_v1.cardinality: one intermediate structural artifact per audit_id
coverage_structural_v1.notes: Generated inside the trusted v3 final gate as the exact frozen file/function/entity accounting input. It is persisted for diagnosis but is not independently authoritative.

coverage_summary.cardinality: one machine-rendered JSON/Markdown pair per audit_id
coverage_summary.notes: R/V/U/N count only materialized atomic checks. Interface candidates and extractor gaps are reported in a separate bounded/unbounded inventory state; an unbounded universe has no numeric conservative percentage. R=0 renders NOT_APPLICABLE, never 100%. The verifier regenerates and byte-compares both JSON semantics and Markdown.

semantic_coverage_verification.notes: Only complete=true authorizes terminal entry-point threat, threat-lens, Focus Area discovery-track, and system attack-chain accounting claims. It requires Attack-chain v2 to bind its evidence to the Finding Adjudication manifest; unresolved chain gaps remain incomplete.

allowed_contents: frozen scope, function, and external-interface manifests
sealed threat model and Focus Areas
disallowed_contents: durable third-party review JSON or Markdown
durable coverage verification or summary JSON
work.promotion_rule: Reusable scripts, Joern rules, static rules, vulnerability cases, and false-positive cases must be promoted by security-skill-optimizer into .opencode/skills/ or .opencode/shared/security-audit/. tmp/ is retained for human review and is not auto-deleted.
